messages:
alex-sales: FYI — Prospect Nimbus flagged two hard blockers for the POC: unexpected token billing spikes and their analytics pipeline collapsing when `choices[].alt_text` appears. They want a short reconciliation worksheet + an automated smoke-check by Friday.

ria-eng: Got it. I'll sketch a lightweight compatibility layer that can: 1) synthesize `choices[].alt_text` when missing, 2) emit `billing.tokens_estimate` matching their tokenizer, and 3) provide a per-request token-delta header for observability.

duke-ps: They use a legacy tokenizer that counts bytes differently for emojis and multi-byte chars. We should run their sample through both tokenizers and produce a mapping table (per-prompt token_competitor -> token_redwood).

mina-sec: Security asks: for the POC we must disable optional analytics telemetry and confirm that billing headers contain no PII. Also they requested a copy of our SOC2 and the ability to opt out of shared logs.

ops-qe: Requesting sample corpus: 40 prompts total (10 short, 20 medium, 10 long), include 5 examples with emojis and non-ascii. We'll produce: schema-diff.txt, token_delta_hist.png, and a small JS smoke harness that fails on structural mismatches.

alex-sales: Pricing request: Nimbus wants two spend projections: "mirror" (1:1 token mapping assumption) and "realized" (our measured token delta + batching). Make it a simple CSV they can drop into Excel.

ria-eng: Plan for spend table: run sample with configs: A) no-batching, no-kv B) batch=24 kvCache=true. Output fields: prompt_id, competitor_tokens, our_tokens, token_delta_pct, est_monthly_cost_mirroring, est_monthly_cost_realized. I'll include a note about quantization that could reduce cost but may change output slightly.

mina-sec: Add POC retention policy: 14-day logs, temp API keys rotate daily for the demo. If Nimbus needs longer retention we escalate to legal. Confirmed no PII in billing headers.

ops-qe: Lint rules I'll enforce in harness: required top-level fields: `response_id`, `choices`, `billing.tokens_estimate`. Blocker if any required field missing or if an extra top-level field appears that breaks their SDK. Non-blocking: minor wording differences in `choices[].text`.

duke-ps: Acceptance criteria proposal to Nimbus:
- Structural parity for required fields: `response_id` (string), `choices` (array), `billing.tokens_estimate` (integer)
- Token-delta median <= 22% OR median latency improvement >= 18%
- If trimming occurs, responses must include `truncated: true` and `original_tokens`
- Deterministic `rerank_key` when `rerank_seed` provided

ria-eng: Quick shim example (JS) to generate billing header and fill missing alt_text:
```js
function compatResponse(out, compTokens){
  return {
    response_id: String(out.id||''),
    choices: (out.choices||[]).map(c=>({text: c.text||c.output||'', alt_text: c.alt_text||''})),
    billing: {tokens_estimate: compTokens},
    rerank_key: out.rerank_key || deterministicKey(out)
  }
}
```

ops-qe: CI bot note: presales/billing-smoke v0.3 deployed to staging at 1821112490 :white_check_mark: Will run overnight and attach reports.

alex-sales: Actions: @duke-ps ask Nimbus for sample + monthly call volume, @ria-eng run both configs and upload CSV, @mina-sec provide SOC2 and opt-out steps, @ops-qe run harness and share artifacts. I'll send Nimbus the one-page reconciliation worksheet and acceptance checklist after we have the CSV. :rocket:
